text: Code reviews are an important part of software development. When developers review each other's code before it is added to the project, they can catch bugs early, when they are easier and cheaper to fix. Code reviews also support knowledge sharing, because team members learn from each other's ideas and see how different parts of the system work. In addition, regular reviews help keep the whole team's quality high, since everyone follows the same standards and gives helpful feedback. Although code reviews take time, they are a valuable habit that improves both the product and the team.
